name: github
description: Connect official GitHub tools and bundled git/gh commands with hob-bot sign-in, your own GitHub App, or a personal access token, with automatic Hob attribution.

GITHUB_APP_ID.title: GitHub App ID
GITHUB_APP_ID.description: 想用自己的 GitHub App 身份操作时填，和私钥路径一起填。PR、评论和提交都会显示成这个 App 的机器人。

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.title: GitHub App 私钥路径
GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.description: 本机上 App 私钥（.pem 文件）的路径，只在本机用来签名，不会上传。

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: 个人访问令牌
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: 在 [GitHub](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens) 创建，以你本人的身份操作。填了 App 或用 hob-bot 登录后，优先用那两种。

ATTRIBUTION.title: 署名 Hob
ATTRIBUTION.description: 开 PR、开 issue 时在正文末尾加一行「Generated with Hob」，提交时把 hob-bot 加为共同作者。

summary.zh: 连接 GitHub 官方工具与 git/gh 命令行，支持 hob-bot 登录、自有 GitHub App 或个人访问令牌，自动带 Hob 署名。
summary.en: Connect official GitHub tools and git/gh commands via hob-bot sign-in, your own GitHub App, or a personal access token, with automatic Hob attribution.

description.zh:
通过官方 GitHub 远程 MCP 与内置 git/gh 命令行封装操作仓库、Issue 与 PR，并自动附带 Hob 署名。支持三种身份（按优先级依次回退）：
1. 自有 GitHub App（填写 App ID 与私钥路径）：完全以该 App 机器人身份操作，提交作者也是该机器人；未安装到目标仓库时自动回退。
2. hob-bot 登录（点击上方「登录」完成设备码授权，无需手动建令牌）：以你本人的身份操作，GitHub 上显示的是你；PR 和 issue 正文末尾带「Generated with Hob」，提交里 hob-bot 是共同作者。
3. 个人访问令牌（GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN）：完全兼容 1.0，升级后无需改动即可继续使用。
description.en:
Operate GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests via the official GitHub remote MCP server and bundled git/gh wrappers with automatic Hob attribution. Supports three identities in priority order:
1. Your own GitHub App (App ID + private key path): acts completely as your App bot, including commit author; automatically falls back on repositories where the App is not installed.
2. hob-bot sign-in (click Sign In above for device-code login, no token setup needed): acts as you, so GitHub shows you; new PRs and issues end with "Generated with Hob" and commits list hob-bot as co-author.
3. Personal Access Token (GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN): fully backwards-compatible with 1.0.
